deployment/README.md:414:#### TileServer-GL
deployment/README.md:417:- **Function**: Vector tile server for base map rendering
deployment/README.md:418:- **Setup Required**: Generate mbtiles using Planetiler (see [Generating Map Tiles](#generating-map-tiles-with-planetiler) below)
deployment/README.md:420:  - `tiles/*.mbtiles` - Vector tile data (user-generated, not included in repo)
deployment/README.md:421:  - `tiles/config.json` - TileServer configuration
deployment/README.md:428:- **Data Source**: Mbtiles generated from Planetiler (OSM data)
deployment/README.md:460:#### Generating Map Tiles with Planetiler
deployment/README.md:462:[Planetiler](https://github.com/onthegomap/planetiler) is a fast tool for generating vector tiles from OpenStreetMap data. You need to generate mbtiles before starting the TileServer.
deployment/README.md:475:# Download Planetiler (one-time)
deployment/README.md:476:wget https://github.com/onthegomap/planetiler/releases/latest/download/planetiler.jar
deployment/README.md:479:java -Xmx8g -jar planetiler.jar --download --area=germany --output=germany.mbtiles
deployment/README.md:482:java -Xmx4g -jar planetiler.jar --download --area=berlin --output=berlin.mbtiles
deployment/README.md:494:java -Xmx8g -jar planetiler.jar --osm-path=germany-latest.osm.pbf --output=tiles/germany.mbtiles
deployment/README.md:508:After generating your mbtiles, update `tiles/config.json` to reference your file:
deployment/README.md:514:      "mbtiles": "your-region.mbtiles"
deployment/README.md:524:- **Missing tiles at high zoom**: Planetiler may skip sparse areas; this is normal
deployment/README.md:562:| TileServer-GL         | 1GB          | 512MB              |                                             |
deployment/README.md:748:### TileServer Issues
deployment/README.md:751:   - Ensure mbtiles file exists (generate with Planetiler - see [Generating Map Tiles](#generating-map-tiles-with-planetiler))
deployment/README.md:752:   - Verify `tiles/config.json` references the correct mbtiles file
deployment/README.md:753:2. Check TileServer logs: `docker-compose logs tileserver`
deployment/README.md:754:3. Verify mbtiles file exists: `ls -lh deployment/tiles/*.mbtiles`
deployment/README.md:758:7. For missing or outdated tiles: Regenerate mbtiles from Planetiler with updated OSM data
